reviews.review_msg: The course is boring and tests get harder each week. The final exam used AI music so no one could CHEAT but it was extremely hard. Don't expect a high grade. Lectures are dry and long. I didn't really learn from the course even though it was for beginners.

he discloses in the syllabus that the entire class is made by AI. you pay thousands of dollars at 'canada's most engaged university' to take an online class created entirely by AI. it's heavily listening based where he uses AI songs to quiz you on how to track the beat of the song but because the song is AI it sounds like autotuned TV static.
